title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up appointment today.

HPI
Patient presents for routine follow-up as scheduled. He reports feeling generally stable since the last visit. He denies any new shortness of breath, swelling, or palpitations. He confirms adherence to all prescribed medications and reports taking the full dose of all items on his medication list. He denies any recent changes in diet or activity level.

Medication List
Current medications include: sacubitril-valsartan, carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, furosemide, spironolactone.

Exam
Vitals: Blood pressure 128/78, pulse 72, respiratory rate 16. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Peripheral edema is 1+ bilaterally. The patient appears comfortable at rest.

Assessment
Patient is stable on current regimen. No acute changes noted today.

Plan
Continue current medication list as prescribed. Encourage continued monitoring of weight and daily activity. Return to clinic as scheduled for next follow-up.
explanations: Heart-failure medications on the list do not establish the diagnosis; coders do not infer diagnoses from medications.

distractors.why: Only the provider can document a diagnosis.
